title.narrative: Increased capacities of labour administration and social partners to improve workplace compliance and prevent forced labour

description.narrative: This CPO will support the tripartite constituents in Uzbekistan to promote a safe and healthy working environment. The efforts will be focused on improving the labour inspection and occupational safety and health (OSH) systems of Uzbekistan. Also, ILO will engage in promoting an integrated approach to Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work (FPRW) in the cotton supply chain by introducing ecological cotton cultivation techniques protective of occupational health, access to professional financial and insurance services and to alternative marketing channels.
